actionable_recommendations: Conduct a thorough planning phase for fundraising campaigns.
Perform a feasibility study to gauge potential success.
claims_requiring_current_verification: Joanne Toller claims small nonprofits can raise $20K–$100K in about 90 days.
major_ideas: The importance of planning in fundraising campaigns.
The necessity of having committed board and donor support for successful fundraising.
prerequisites: Commitment from the board and donors to shared philanthropic goals.
proposed_workflow: Identify your fundraising goals and objectives.
Engage stakeholders including board members and donors in the planning process.
Conduct the feasibility study to evaluate the project's financial viability.
title: The #1 Mistake That Kills Nonprofit Campaigns
